remarks: Enjoy the luxury of a fully renovated 5 bedroom home set on nearly three manicured acres complete with pool, spa, and your own par 3 hole for off-season golf practice! High-end gourmet kitchen with seamless flow to indoor and outdoor entertaining areas creates the perfect house for entertaining. Four generously sized bedrooms are located on the upper floor with the primary bedroom featuring access to upper deck, large walk-in closet, oversized bathroom with steam shower, complete with 8 faucet heads. Finished lower level is the perfect hang-out space with TV viewing, pool table, bar, 5th bedroom & full bath and well-equipped gym. Live, Work, Play - this property has it all! And to top it off, a red-light sauna will be a great way to end the day! Offered furnished for the months of Oct 1 2025 - June 1 2026, monthly rent includes all utilities & maintenance costs.
